title: WhatsApp groups now show up in TD Social
text: When a client creates a WhatsApp group (or adds the business number to one), it now appears in the WhatsApp tab within about a minute, with a green "Group" label. Every message shows who in the group wrote it. A group you hide stays hidden when someone writes in it. Replying to a group from the CRM is not available yet — reply from the phone for now. Groups were switched off on purpose before; this turns them on.
points: New groups appear within a minute
Green Group label in the list
Each message shows who wrote it

steps.name: Open the WhatsApp tab
steps.detail: A new group is at the top of the list.

steps.name: Look for the green Group label
steps.detail: The name is the group's own name.

steps.name: Open it to read
steps.detail: Each message shows who wrote it. Reply from the phone for now.
